name: Aizaki Souta
source:
The protagonist. An ordinary student. He has known the sisters since he was born, and their relationship is like that of an older sister and younger brother. He is interested in sexual matters, as his normal for his age, but perhaps because he was surrounded by the sisters, he can be a little passive. He is confused by the changes in the sisters, but goes with the flow.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc089/index.html#character]Official Site[/url]]
